name: Diwali Mela Online — Mela Chaloge Mere Sath?
description: Enter an interactive 3D Diwali Mela in your browser. Walk through glowing diya-lit stalls, play balloon shooting and ring toss, eat garam jalebi and chaat, ride the giant wheel, light earthen diyas, and celebrate the Akashdeep sky lantern and fireworks finale.
